title: a_short_regime_daily_ledger
description: Persisted append-only ledger of per-trade-day A-share regime feature rows for the V14.3 comparison-only classifier (design slice 2b-cadence). Each row matches a_short_market_regime_daily; the ledger lets the 252d rolling-percentile window be read without recomputing 252 days of daily+stk_limit per weekly run. This schema pins the envelope + const cadence policy + comparison-only boundary; integrity invariants JSON Schema cannot express are enforced by the Python gates in engine.a_short_regime_ledger: validate_ledger_for_append / validate_ledger enforce rows sorted/contiguous/PIT, coverage matches rows, canonical dates, and each row valid against the daily schema (finite floats, net_limit); merge_rows enforces ONLY append-only immutability (it is merge-only and does NOT validate daily-row semantics — the caller must run the gates before write/read). NON-production: V14.2 stays frozen; this drives nothing and is written only under the guard-safe research lane, never result/a_short.

policy.description: const-pinned so the cadence contract cannot drift

append_rule.const: contiguous trading days in (last_ledger_date, as_of]; bootstrap = the last backfill_min trading days <= as_of; existing dates immutable; never > as_of

rows.description: ascending-by-as_of daily-feature rows; full row contract + contiguity/PIT enforced by validate_ledger against a_short_market_regime_daily.schema.json
